title: Nunes Dairy, Clay Tile Silo, 9854 Bruceville Road, Elk Grove, Sacramento County, CA
notes: Significance: This silo is distinctive in its design and construction material.  The use of hollow clay tiles is unusual for the Central California region and appears unique in the Elk Grove area.  In contrast, most of the surviving silos in the local area were constructed of concrete rings bound together with iron bands.
